title: Surfing Kovalam Beach, South Indian Small, Fun Waves - GoPro Footage
what_it_shows: GoPro selfie/POV surf clip at Kovalam Beach near Trivandrum (Kerala). Uploader's own description explicitly names the artificial reef: "there is an artificial reef that really goes off when the swell is big enough." Short, mostly a surfer selfie and wave whitewash, no narration.

title: Kovalam Surf Club social video
what_it_shows: Short social-media style clip whose thumbnail is captioned "MEET JELLE RIGOLE FROM BELGIUM" — this is the same Jelle Rigole quoted in the dossier [R1] as founder of a local Kovalam surf club describing the reef's collapse ("waves just roll over the reef now without even breaking"). Confirms this video is tied to the exact site/community in the dossier, not a different Kovalam-named place.

title: Surfing - Water Sports in Kovalam, Kerala
what_it_shows: Official Kerala sports-tourism promotional clip of surfing at Kovalam, Kerala, describing wave heights (0.5-2 m) and surf-tourism infrastructure. General Kovalam surf/beach footage, not reef-construction-specific, but explicitly located at Kovalam, Kerala (confirms the correct site, distinct from the similarly-named Covelong Point near Chennai).
